records.name: Special Beam Blast
records.effect: Jumps backward and fires a long-range Special Beam Cannon; single-hit knockback.
records.availability_note: Future Warrior acquisition is explicitly documented via TP Medal Shop; character/partner users listed separately do not make the skill character-exclusive.

records.name: Break Strike
records.effect: Creates a close-range explosion that launches the opponent upward.

records.name: Celestial Wave
records.effect: Launches a seven-hit blue energy wave into the air.

records.name: Chaos Wall
records.unlock_method: Conton City Tournament Match 4 - Semifinal Showdown
records.effect: Creates a rainbow Ki wall that nullifies/deflects Ki Blasts; holding the input enlarges and strengthens it.

notes: Special Beam Blast is CaC-usable because the Future Warrior can purchase it from the TP Medal Shop; the category page's character-user table should not be interpreted as an exclusivity statement. Break Strike remains CaC-usable from Skill Shop. Celestial Wave remains character-only in the reviewed evidence. Chaos Wall remains CaC-usable through the Conton City Tournament route, with Ultimate Finish requirement unresolved.
